section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a one-item dietary restraint measure taken from the Restraint subscale of the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q) used as a standalone daily-diary item; participants rated the statement from 1 (not at all) to 5 (frequently). Mean scores on this brief measure were strongly correlated with the EDE-Q Restraint subscale (r = .67), and average weekly dietary restraint across participants was 2.15 (SD = 1.02). The section does not label this as 'Study 1' or indicate multiple studies.
section_summary.evidence_source: Quoted sentences from the section: "A one-item measure taken from the Restraint subscale of the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q; Fairburn & Beglin, 1994) assessed dietary restraint, in line with prior research using this item as a standalone measure (Kelly & Stephen, 2016)." "The statement, "I have been trying to limitthe amount and/or types of food I eat in order to influence my shape or weight (whether or notIhave succeeded)" was ratedbyparticipants from1 (not at all)to 5 (frequently) according to their eating habits that day." "Mean scores on this brief measure across study days were strongly correlated with scores on the Restraint subscale of the EDE-Q (r = .67), which was administered 4–6 days before the daily diary stage of data collection." "Average weekly dietary restraint across participants was 2.15 (SD = 1.02)."
